term: simple priority of beings versus mixed-token existential-production priority
resolution: The old causal-loop result uses the sourced simple-priority vocabulary on beings. The existential-self-production result uses a separate supplied Prior on Sum B E, where inl labels bearer/product existence tokens and inr labels acts. Reusing the same logical irreflexivity/transitivity templates does not source or establish them on that mixed domain. Its two productive interfaces and both structural laws are separately named unattributed open premises. Neither relation is temporal precedence by definition; no source fidelity or actual bearer-presence claim transfers merely by notation. Not forked (batch 4 of #1233): already type-distinct. Simple priority relates beings (B → B → Prop); the other senses concern a Prior on Sum B E, and the irreflexive/transitive records are structural laws on it, not readings. DEF-SIMPLE-PRIORITY reaches the root through DISAMB-PRIORITY-SIMPLE-OR-IN-TIME, which is forked. Since PR #1526 the mixed-domain uses also lie on a root route: argument e9a9eeaf (no self-origin from productive exercise and no self-production) links this record, and its premise NoSelfProduction has the certified support route from BearerPrior, ProductPrior, IrreflexivePriority and TransitivePriority on one supplied Prior over Sum B E. Every use on that route reads the mixed domain, and the simple priority of beings is a different Lean type, so passing between the two remains a type error; no coverage or exclusivity is used. Open taxonomy issue: senses 2-5 are interfaces and structural laws of ONE mixed relation, not rival readings, so the batch generator rejected registering the asymmetry route (docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md) as a mixing of senses that would need a misleading sense bridge.
